```{r}
expected_composition <- bind_rows(
  expected_standard %>%
    mutate(control_type = "Community"),

  expected_standard %>%
    mutate(control_type = "DNA"),

  expected_gut %>%
    mutate(control_type = "Gut")
) %>%
  select(control_type, species, expected_percent)

# Umbral mínimo para la validación principal. La composición completa se
# conserva en expected_composition, pero no se evalúan cuantitativamente los
# taxones cuya abundancia teórica es inferior al 0.1 %.
min_expected_percent <- 0.1
```


# Controles taxonomía

```{r}
#Cargar en una única tabla todos los report de bracken
files = dir("../TAX-TAXPROFILER/bracken/db2/",pattern = ".report_bracken_species.txt", full.names = T)
tabla_raw <- import_kraken(files,threads = 20)

     controls_list <- c("Community-2", "COMUNITY-1", "CONTROL-DNA-2", "DNA-CONTROL-1", "Gut-1", "Gut-microbiome-2")
     
tabla <- tabla_raw %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = gsub(
      "_pe_run1_db2.bracken.kraken2.report_bracken_species.txt",
      "",
      Sample
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Sample %in% control_samples$Sample)


DT::datatable(tabla[1:6])
```

# Extraer únicamente los resultados de Kraken a nivel de especie
```{r}
observed_species <- tabla %>%
  filter(TaxRank == "S") %>%
  transmute(
    Sample,
    species_original = str_squish(Name2),
    species = str_squish(Name2),
    observed_percent = as.numeric(Prop),
    observed_reads = as.numeric(Reads)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = case_when(
      species == "Limosilactobacillus fermentum" ~
        "Lactobacillus fermentum",

      TRUE ~ species
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, species) %>%
  summarise(
    observed_percent = sum(observed_percent),
    observed_reads = sum(observed_reads),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(control_samples, by = "Sample")
```

Crear todas las combinaciones esperadas por muestra
```{r}
comparison_design <- control_samples %>%
  left_join(
    expected_composition,
    by = "control_type"
  ) %>%
  filter(expected_percent >= min_expected_percent)
```

Comprobar primero los nombres que no coinciden
```{r}
expected_not_matched <- comparison_design %>%
  anti_join(
    observed_species,
    by = c(
      "Sample",
      "control_type",
      "replicate",
      "control_label",
      "species"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(control_type, replicate, desc(expected_percent))

expected_not_matched %>% select(species) %>% unique()
```
Lactobacillus fermentum = "Limosilactobacillus fermentum" (CAMBIADO)
Saccharomyces cerevisiae = HONGO			
Cryptococcus neoformans	= HONGO	
Candida albicans	= HONGO



# Tabla final esperado–observado

```{r}
comparison <- comparison_design %>%
  left_join(
    observed_species %>%
      select(
        Sample,
        species,
        observed_percent,
        observed_reads
      ),
    by = c("Sample", "species")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    observed_percent = replace_na(observed_percent, 0),
    observed_reads = replace_na(observed_reads, 0),

    detected = observed_reads > 0,

    difference_pp =
      observed_percent - expected_percent,

    absolute_error_pp =
      abs(observed_percent - expected_percent),

    recovery_ratio =
      observed_percent / expected_percent,

    log2_recovery_ratio = if_else(
      observed_percent > 0,
      log2(observed_percent / expected_percent),
      NA_real_
    ),

    expected_abundance_group = case_when(
      expected_percent >= 0.1  ~ "Quantifiable",
      expected_percent >= 0.01 ~ "Low abundance",
      TRUE                     ~ "Trace abundance"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    control_type,
    replicate,
    desc(expected_percent),
    species
  )

DT::datatable(
  comparison %>%
    select(
      control_label,
      species,
      expected_percent,
      observed_percent,
      observed_reads,
      detected,
      difference_pp,
      recovery_ratio,
      expected_abundance_group
    )
)
```
```{r}
not_detected <- comparison %>%
  filter(!detected) %>%
  select(
    control_label,
    species,
    expected_percent,
    expected_abundance_group
  )

not_detected
```
# Para resumir cuántas réplicas recuperaron cada microorganismo:
```{r}
replicate_recovery <- comparison %>%
  group_by(
    control_type,
    species,
    expected_percent
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    replicates_detected = sum(detected),
    total_replicates = n(),
    mean_observed_percent = mean(observed_percent),
    min_observed_percent = min(observed_percent),
    max_observed_percent = max(observed_percent),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

replicate_recovery
```

```{r}
qc_summary <- comparison %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    control_type,
    replicate,
    control_label
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    expected_taxa = n(),

    detected_taxa = sum(detected),

    detection_rate_percent =
      100 * sum(detected) / n(),

    quantifiable_taxa =
      sum(expected_percent >= 0.1),

    detected_quantifiable_taxa =
      sum(detected & expected_percent >= 0.1),

    detection_rate_quantifiable_percent =
      100 *
      sum(detected & expected_percent >= 0.1) /
      sum(expected_percent >= 0.1),

    observed_abundance_expected_taxa =
      sum(observed_percent),

    mean_absolute_error_pp =
      mean(
        absolute_error_pp[
          expected_percent >= 0.1
        ]
      ),

    root_mean_squared_error_pp =
      sqrt(
        mean(
          difference_pp[
            expected_percent >= 0.1
          ]^2
        )
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

qc_summary
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
library(scales)

comparison_plot <- comparison %>%
  mutate(
    species = forcats::fct_reorder(
      species,
      expected_percent
    )
  )

p_controls <- ggplot(
  comparison_plot,
  aes(y = species)
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = expected_percent,
      xend = observed_percent,
      yend = species
    ),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "grey70"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = expected_percent,
      shape = "Expected"
    ),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = observed_percent,
      shape = "Observed"
    ),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~control_label,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(
      sigma = 0.0001,
      base = 10
    ),
    breaks = c(
      0,
      0.0001,
      0.001,
      0.01,
      0.1,
      1,
      10,
      100
    ),
    labels = scales::label_number()
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Expected" = 1,
      "Observed" = 16
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Relative abundance (%)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey95"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "italic"
    )
  )

p_controls
```

# Heatmap de abundancia esperada frente a observada

El heatmap utiliza una escala lineal y solamente incluye los microorganismos con
una abundancia esperada igual o superior al 0.1 %. Cada panel corresponde a una
muestra control y contiene una columna con la abundancia teórica y otra con la
abundancia estimada por Bracken.

```{r controls-expected-observed-heatmap, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
controls_heatmap_data <- comparison %>%
  select(
    control_type,
    replicate,
    control_label,
    species,
    expected_percent,
    observed_percent
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(expected_percent, observed_percent),
    names_to = "abundance_type",
    values_to = "relative_abundance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    abundance_type = recode(
      abundance_type,
      expected_percent = "Expected",
      observed_percent = "Observed"
    ),
    abundance_type = factor(
      abundance_type,
      levels = c("Expected", "Observed")
    ),
    control_label = factor(
      control_label,
      levels = c(
        "Community 1",
        "Community 2",
        "DNA 1",
        "DNA 2",
        "Gut 1",
        "Gut 2"
      )
    ),
    abundance_label = scales::number(
      relative_abundance,
      accuracy = 0.01,
      trim = TRUE
    ),
    label_colour = if_else(relative_abundance >= 7, "white", "black")
  )

controls_heatmap <- ggplot(
  controls_heatmap_data,
  aes(x = abundance_type, y = species, fill = relative_abundance)
) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = abundance_label, colour = label_colour),
    size = 3.4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~control_label,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "#0072B2",
    limits = c(0, max(controls_heatmap_data$relative_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)),
    name = "Relative abundance (%)"
  ) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  labs(
    title = "Expected and observed taxonomic composition of mock controls",
    subtitle = "Taxa with expected relative abundance ≥ 0.1%",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

controls_heatmap

ggsave(
  "controls_expected_observed_heatmap.png",
  controls_heatmap,
  width = 11,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
supplementary_mock_table <- comparison %>%
  mutate(
    detection_status = case_when(
      !detected ~ "Not detected",

      recovery_ratio >= 0.5 &
        recovery_ratio <= 2 ~
        "Detected, within two-fold of expected",

      TRUE ~
        "Detected, outside two-fold of expected"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    control_type,
    replicate,
    control_label,
    species,
    expected_percent,
    observed_percent,
    observed_reads,
    detected,
    difference_pp,
    recovery_ratio,
    expected_abundance_group,
    detection_status
  )

supplementary_mock_table

write_csv(
  supplementary_mock_table,
  "Supplementary_mock_controls.csv"
)
```

```{r}
controls_table_long <- comparison %>%
  transmute(
    Control = control_type,
    Replicate = replicate,
    Sample = control_label,
    Species = species,
    Expected_percent = expected_percent,
    WGS_percent = observed_percent,
    Reads = observed_reads,
    Detected = if_else(detected, "Yes", "No"),
    Difference_pp = observed_percent - expected_percent,
    Recovery_percent = if_else(
      expected_percent > 0,
      100 * observed_percent / expected_percent,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = factor(
      Sample,
      levels = c(
        "Community 1",
        "Community 2",
        "DNA 1",
        "DNA 2",
        "Gut 1",
        "Gut 2"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Sample,
    desc(Expected_percent),
    Species
  )

write_csv(
  controls_table_long,
  "controls_table_long.csv"
)
WriteXLS(
  controls_table_long,
  "controls_table_long.xlsx",
   row.names = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
controls_table_wide <- controls_table_long %>%
  select(
    Sample,
    Species,
    Expected_percent,
    WGS_percent
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = c(
      Expected_percent,
      WGS_percent
    ),
    names_glue = "{Sample}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  select(
    Species,

    `Community 1_Expected_percent`,
    `Community 1_WGS_percent`,

    `Community 2_Expected_percent`,
    `Community 2_WGS_percent`,

    `DNA 1_Expected_percent`,
    `DNA 1_WGS_percent`,

    `DNA 2_Expected_percent`,
    `DNA 2_WGS_percent`,

    `Gut 1_Expected_percent`,
    `Gut 1_WGS_percent`,

    `Gut 2_Expected_percent`,
    `Gut 2_WGS_percent`
  )

write_csv(
  controls_table_wide,

)
WriteXLS(
```
